description: This file defines a singleton class 'PolicyQueryCommandMappingStrategies' which provides mapping strategies (from signal types to JsonifiableMapper instances) for various policy query commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains logic to initialize and store mappings used for serializing or handling policy query commands.
